evidence: Runnable calculations on one lake model (biosphere/ecology/lake.py, as corrected after the independent review of 18 October) forced from one GCM's climate at T21: the resort at 301 K is the lock's weather moved by climate_targets' share of the way on the ground's temperature, the construction that reproduces the waters' oxygen study's 300 K runs exactly; each lake is a band lake's hypsography scaled to its floor, with oxygen demand from bounded scenarios of Earth's lakes, and the stirring below the night's mixing set by the share of the wind's energy Earth's lakes pass to their stratified water (Wuest, Piepke & Van Senden 2000), 0.3% with the bracket 0.2-0.4% on the 352 m lakes and a giant, the flux on Wuest & Lorke's lake drag (the drag behind the measured share is open). The census is arithmetic on geography's drainage product (a first estimate from the climate run A28_dim5_moon, which regenerates after the design case), LOLA at 16 pixels a degree and groundwater stage 2 re-solved from its own heads; the closed lakes' soda follows the sea chemistry's box model scaled by each lake's turnover; the remedies are lake_anoxia's Earth-based sizes at 301 K; the moorings and the reservoirs' rule are proposed designs. No lunar lake has been measured.
reading_rule: Oxygen in g/m3 (mg/L), areas in km2 of lake surface, depths in m. ladder is keyed band, floor depth (m) and trophic state, each with its own physics and its own renewal/supply column, with the wind's deep mixing at its central share, and ladder_eta the 352 m lakes' oligotrophic and mesotrophic water at its bracket (low 0.2%, high 0.4%); each case's deep_mixing gives the dissipation the wind gave and the shares of the interfaces at and held back by the cap; night_mixing_m gives the 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th and 90th percentiles of each night's deepest mixing; floor shares are of the lake's bed in plan; episodes group consecutive lunar cycles with a complete overturn. thresholds.ventilated_depth_m is the floor depth to which the nights mix a lake to its floor on half the nights (half), and on a quarter and three quarters of them, interpolated in the log of the depth between the ladder's rungs, with a bound where the rungs do not bracket it; ordinary_night_mixing_352m_m gives the 352 m lakes' nights that stop short of the floor and night_mixing_all_nights_352m_m every night's. census.kinds sort every body by its deepest point against its band's ventilated depth for oligotrophic water at the wind's central share, and the edges 50 and 1,000 m (by_share_of_nights at the quarter and three quarters); census.by_trophic and census.by_trophic_eta sort them under each state's own ventilated depth and at the share's bracket; census.within_each_rung_by_band counts the bodies whose deepest point lies within each of the ladder's floor depths, by band, which brackets the self-ventilated kind between the rungs the ventilated depth is interpolated across; floor_by_depth_km2 gives each kind's floor in lake_anoxia's classes (floor_depth_edges_m), to multiply by the methane study's fluxes per area of floor. Closed bodies are those with at least half their cells in depressions that do not spill. Years to salinities and chemoclines are per closed part, area-weighted medians over a kind; triples run [high, central, low] weathering where named. spring_water is at the 352 m oligotrophic lakes' mean bottom temperature, the one spring_fed reads. giants and meromictic hold the fifty saved years after each one's spin-up. Powers in kW per km2 of lake and GW in total; needs.oxygenation_for_deep_water_life takes each trophic state's rate per km2 for the deep kind and the giants together; built_lakes gives a new reservoir's first-decade oxygen as consumed and as delivered, up to three times it as the devices' stirring raises the demand. Phosphorus loads in g P per m2 a year, with lake_anoxia's settling brackets and anoxic_floors, the retention cancelled, the most anoxic floors can do at steady state.

meromixis_candidates.rule: closed parts whose deepest point lies beyond the ventilated depth: once their salinity passes the salinity at which a wet spell's freshening of the mixed layer outweighs the margin, they can hold a chemocline through the cold spells

spring_fed.rule: inflow per area of the 15 km lakes (or, for a body too small for that grid, its band's inflow per metre of shore along its own shore), spread over the floor, the part below the ventilated depth entering the deep layer at the deep water's temperature with the springs' density excess; a candidate builds the margin within the longest stretch its kind of lake goes without an overturn

monitoring.rule: one profiling mooring at the deepest point of every lake deeper than the ventilated depth and of at least 1 km2, and one more for each further 2000 km2; smaller ones profiled from boats or a sensor string; the self-ventilated lakes watched from orbit and the shore
